title: 上海高考翻译背诵-87-某市重

items.zh: 随着幕布升起，首次亮相的演员们随着音乐的节拍尽情载歌载舞。
items.en: With the curtain rising, the actors, making their debut, danced and sang to the beat of the music with elation.

items.zh: 从双子山可以俯瞰远处的温室花园，其光影效果增添了它的神秘氛围。
items.en: From the Twin Hills, you can overlook the Greenhouse Garden, whose light and shadow effects add to mysterious atmosphere.

items.zh: 这个由传统手工艺工坊改造的产业园区，不仅保留了文化底蕴，还在品牌升级和转型方面打了头阵。
items.en: The industrial park, transformed from a traditional handicraft workshop, not only preserves cultural heritage but also takes the lead in brand upgrading and transformation.

items.zh: 当这个身着格子衬衫的中年人在会议上发言时，与其说是他渊博的学识，倒不如说是他的幽默感给在场的贵宾留下了深刻的印象。
items.en: As the middle-aged man in a checked shirt addressed the meeting, it was not so much his extensive knowledge as his sense of humor that impressed the distinguished guests present.
